name: aurora-for-elementor
description: Build tooling for Aurora for Elementor. Aurora itself ships as plain PHP/JS/CSS (no build step required to run the plugin) — Vite here is only a developer convenience for maintaining the Text Animation module's per-effect source files (assets/js/src/) and compiling them into the flat, framework-free bundles the plugin actually loads (assets/js/dist/). The compiled dist/ files ARE committed, so end users never need Node/npm.
